main.name: Or Goren
main.description: Fourth year software engineering student from Tel-Aviv.
main.bio:
Beyond my studies and work, I’m someone who cares about people and growth. Volunteering with MDA and working with at-risk youth helped me develop emotional intelligence, resilience, and being part of something with much greater meaning than what I was used to.

I like working with different kinds of people, taking initiative, and being someone others can rely on. I bring a practical mindset, strong teamwork, adaptability, and a real desire to make a positive impact wherever I am.

projects.url: The project focuses on analyzing the Northwind database using Tableau. It presents insights into sales, customers, and products through clear and interactive dashboards. The project enables identifying key trends, analyzing performance by categories, and spotting opportunities to improve sales.
